main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean 3-day excess return (forward return minus coin's mean 3-day return)

statistic.name: t of weighted mean, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: positive with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: negative with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess above median forecast minus below median

decided_by: The t of the main measure lies between -2 and 2.
reading: The falling-calm profile is read from the recorded regime ('unknown' = no veto fired) and the 7-day rise from the sign of the raw component (7-day close return where missing); all coins in the record are used; the t of the weighted mean uses per-day sums of weighted deviations (clustered standard error with G/(G-1) correction); the median split drops cases exactly at the median and compares unweighted mean excess returns.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +1.262 (not below 1), 389 cases (30 needed)
